$comment: What a reader of the working-on format must make of sample/, the initiative root beside this file.
The format is the working-on skill (~/claudecode/skills/working-on/SKILL.md); where the skill is silent,
accepted_reading below is the reading, and the skill points here. Readers: the record
(record/internal/kb/workingon, Read) and Deltagos (organizer/internal/scan, ReadInitiative). Each reads
sample/ in its own tests and compares with this file; readers_today records where each one differs
today (2026-10-25, record at ~/hestia-monorepo/record, Deltagos at ~/organizer), which is their cards' work.
A change to the format changes sample/ and this file first.

list_fields.scalar_fields: superseded_by, seat, stage, next and the dates are scalars.
list_fields.rule: A field the skill writes as a list also accepts one scalar, read as a one-item list (`boundary: "<prose>"` is one boundary entry). An empty scalar is an empty list.

accepted_reading.spec: `spec` (and `gate`) is written as one scalar; a list is accepted and read as several references, the first being the one a builder is launched against.
accepted_reading.done_folder: A card under working-on/done/ is done whatever its `status` says. Any other status there is reported as a problem (the card is still read).
accepted_reading.unknown_card_status: A card status outside card_statuses is kept as written and reported as a problem; it counts in no status bucket.

decision_statuses.note: awaiting-cells, applied and acknowledged are the crossing statuses (working-on templates/crossing.md); they are valid in any decisions/ folder. applied and acknowledged come after the ruling, so they are not waiting.

ruled_by_refused.rule: decisions.md 2026-11-01: a ruled_by value the reader does not know is refused, never read as present. Refused: a parenthesized note other than `(autonomous mode)`, `(away mode)`, `(standing rule)` and a Themis `(FR-4 <x>)` (`pablo (vacation)`); an unclosed or stray parenthesis (`pablo (autonomous mode`); a value of more than one word that ruled_by_reading does not list and that is no `<person> (<mode>)` or `<person> by away mode|standing rule` (`pablo away mode, recommendation taken`, an unlisted old wording). A refused value gives no person, no RULED_BY and no mode: a counted warning on the record (the record is still read for the rest), and no decision fact (facts.reader_refuses).

accepted_reading.ruled_by_note: decisions.md 2026-10-25 ruling 5, amended 2026-11-01 ("ruled_by says autonomous mode; unknown readings refused"): ruled_by has one form ahead (the working-on skill names it: `<person>`, or `<person> (autonomous mode)` | `<person> (standing rule)`); old forms are read, not rewritten. `(away mode)`, `<person> by away mode` and `operator away mode, recommendation taken` are the old names of autonomous mode and read as mode autonomous (the mode's name since 2026-10-18). A bare `(autonomous mode)` or `(away mode)`, with no person, is person pablo, mode autonomous. A ruled_by value listed in ruled_by_modes does not name a person as written: it names a person and a mode, read as ruled_by_reading gives them (the ruling is pablo's, a RULED_BY to person pablo, with the mode beside it). The general forms are read the same way for any person: `<person> (autonomous mode)` | `(away mode)` | `(standing rule)` and `<person> by away mode` | `by standing rule` are that person in that mode. `operator` (Hestia's ask, 2026-10-26) is person pablo, mode present, and is pablo wherever a person is read (`owner: operator` is person pablo too), so no person node is named operator. A single word is a person, read as written, mode present (`pablo` is person pablo, mode present). A Themis ruling `themis (FR-4 <x>)` is person themis, mode standing rule. Anything else is refused (ruled_by_refused), never read as present. The mode is the decision fact's ruled_mode (facts.enums.ruled_mode).

ledgers.rule: A ledger in working-on/ is not a card: skipped silently, no problem, no warning.

atlax_fields.touches: a card's `touches:` is a list of atlax designations (fn:, prod:, loc:, evt., data., rule.), the elements its diff touches; informational. Absent or empty reads as [].
atlax_fields.change_order: a card's `change_order:` is a mapping {adds, modifies, retires}, each a list of designations: the authored elements the card adds (born lifecycle planned), changes and retires. Absent reads as all three empty; a missing key reads as []. Anything else is refused by `atlax verify`. An optional `frozen_at` (RFC 3339) inside it only records the time of the freeze commit.
atlax_fields.freeze: the change order is read as committed at the commit where the card's status first became now (or doing), following the card back through true renames (a git mv into done/, say); a card born now freezes at its first commit. A designation listed later is not in the change order: a later change is a new card, or an amend line the FSE writes.
atlax_fields.readers: both fields are optional; a reader that does not use them reads the card as before (the record and Deltagos render neither yet). Writer: the working-on and spec-craft skills; reader: `atlax verify --card` (claudecode scripts/atlax).

accepted_reading.unread: A card or record whose front-matter is missing, unclosed or not YAML, or a decision whose file name is not NNNN-slug.md, is reported as an unread problem and contributes nothing else.

$comment: Hestia 0042 (frontmatter-fact-ledger, crossing agent-slack 0022, ruled 2026-10-26): the facts the laptop indexer
extracts from sample/ into its ledger (kind, v, key, payload, seq) and forwards to POST /v1/facts (facts-batch.json,
hestia's). Each file is checked against its kind's schema (schemas/) first. Owner of the schemas and the enums:
Hephaistos (Q5). Writers: the working-on, fse, supervise and spec-craft skills (their edits follow this file).
Readers: record's indexer (hestia's cards), then Hestia's projections and the system reader through the facts API.

enums.ruled_mode_note: decisions.md 2026-11-01: autonomous is the mode's value; away is its old name, kept valid (added, not renamed) and read as autonomous wherever ruled_mode is read: a record's written `ruled_mode: away` and a fact row sent before. A writer writes autonomous, and a decision fact's payload carries autonomous for either. `ruled_by: pablo (autonomous mode)` with `ruled_mode: away`, or `pablo (away mode)` with `autonomous`, agree.
enums.note: Hard to undo (review.md, Reversibility): a value is added, never renamed. cause: approach = the approach or its context was wrong or missing; execution = the way was right, the work was not; gate = the gate or the spec was wrong or unclear; environment = environment or process (rebase, limit, tooling, CI); unclear = not known, never guessed.

rules: Every decision, card, run record (one with waves or findings) and spec its schema accepts gives its facts; a file named TEMPLATE*.md is not a record.
A field absent or empty in the file is absent from the payload: nothing is backfilled from prose or guessed (review.md, Trade-offs). The listed payloads are held key by key.
Times are kept as written (RFC 3339 with an offset, minutes enough); dates as YYYY-MM-DD.

decision.ruled_by is the person and decision.ruled_mode the mode, by accepted_reading.ruled_by_reading; a written ruled_mode is the mode (away read as autonomous, enums.ruled_mode_note), and it must agree with ruled_by's (see reader_refuses). A ruled_by that accepted_reading.ruled_by_refused refuses gives no decision fact (reader_refuses).
decision.forecast is {lo, hi} in minutes, from a band at the start of the frontmatter `forecast:` (`60-100m`, `1.5-3h`, `40-90 min ...`, as Argos reads it); no band at the start, no forecast.
decision.raised_in is set only when the decision was raised in the mailbox (Q6).
run is the run record's file name without .md; a finding's n and an amendment's n are 1-based places in their lists.
A file its schema refuses is a counted warning (the `facts` count factory check and /kb/freshness show) and gives no fact; it is still read for the kb as before.
